_doc: Expiring allowlist of KNOWN high/critical PROD-dependency advisories, consumed by scripts/npm-audit-gate.mjs (wired into .github/workflows/security.yml). Mirrors the cargo-audit RUSTSEC_IGNORES discipline in the same workflow. A high/critical in ANY package NOT listed here FAILS the gate. Past `expires`, every entry stops suppressing and the gate re-fails — forcing the dependency-upgrade sprint. Keyed by the top-level npm package name as reported by `npm audit --omit=dev --json`.
_expiryNote: Renewed 2026-07-03, aligned to the cargo-audit allowlist cliff (security.yml — now mechanically ENFORCED there). Entries fixed at lockfile level on 2026-07-03 (next 15.5.20, hono 4.12.25+, http-proxy-middleware 3.0.7, form-data 4.0.6) were REMOVED so future highs in those packages block again. The operator decides whether to run the wagmi-3 sprint (dependabot #181) or extend BOTH allowlists together.

allow.ws: Only remaining vulnerable copies are ws@8.18.0 exact-pinned by nested viem@2.23.2 under @walletconnect/utils@2.21.0 / @reown/appkit* — frozen by @wagmi/connectors@6.2.0 exact pins. Everything reachable within semver was bumped to ws 8.21.0 on 2026-07-03 (api-server direct ws, ethers 6.17.0, socket.io/engine.io chain, top-level viem 2.54.2). Plan: resolved by the wagmi-3 upgrade (dependabot #181).
